user.title: SF Symbols
user.description: Adds Apple's SF Symbols as icon sets `sf:` (Apple names, e.g. `sf:lamp.floor`) and `ios:` (compatible with Cupertino Icons, e.g. `ios:lamp-floor`). There is nothing to configure. Afterwards reload the browser (if needed twice, because of the browser cache).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

create_entry.default: SF Symbols is set up. Reload the browser so the icon sets `sf:` and `ios:` load – if icons stay empty, reload a second time (the browser may still have the old page cached).

data_missing.message: The symbol data is missing or damaged ({error}). Reinstall the integration.

cupertino_installed.title: Cupertino Icons is still installed
cupertino_installed.description:
Cupertino Icons and SF Symbols both provide the icon set `ios:`. SF Symbols takes over `ios:` and resolves every Cupertino name, so Cupertino Icons is no longer needed.

Remove the Cupertino Icons integration (and, if installed through HACS, the repository) and restart Home Assistant. This message disappears afterwards.
